# RRBB

> > A comprehensive accounting, tax, and financial advisory firm serving businesses and individuals across New Jersey and New York with specialized expertise in tax planning, audit, valuation, and IRS representation.

RRBB (Roth, Rosen & Baldinger) is a full-service accounting and consulting firm with deep expertise in business accounting, tax strategy, estate planning, and litigation support. The firm serves a diverse clientele including businesses, high-net-worth individuals, and organizations across multiple industries.

## Key Topics

- Accounting Services
- Tax Planning
- Tax Preparation
- Business Valuation
- IRS Representation
- Audit Services
- Estate & Trust Tax
- International Tax
- Payroll Services
- Litigation Support
- Retirement Planning
- Financial Planning
- Mergers & Acquisitions
- New Jersey
- New York

## Core Services

- [Accounting Services for Businesses](https://rrbb.com/services/for-businesses): Business accounting, audit, tax planning, and CFO services
- [Individual Tax & Wealth Management](https://rrbb.com/services/individuals): Individual tax planning, retirement, and wealth management services
- [Estate + Trust Tax](https://rrbb.com/services/estate-trust-tax): Estate planning, trust tax, and asset allocation services
- [International Tax Services](https://rrbb.com/services/international-tax): International tax preparation and global tax strategy services
- [IRS Representation + Tax Problem Resolution](https://rrbb.com/services/irs-representation-tax-problem-resolution): IRS audit defense, back taxes, liens, and tax problem resolution
- [Litigation Support and Valuations](https://rrbb.com/services/valuation-and-litigation-support): Business valuation, litigation support, and forensic accounting
- [Industry-Specific Services](https://rrbb.com/services/industries): Industry-specific accounting and consulting services
